pick.mechanic_fr: Une grande mobilisation lycéenne contre la suppression de Parcoursup débouche sur des blocages et manifestations qui convergent vers le 10e, empêchant l'accès au Mistral et forçant sa fermeture temporaire.
pick.why: Student protests block the neighborhood and directly disrupt Le Mistral and the inheritance timeline.

draft.premise_fr: Après une omelette brûlée, Lila découvre une affiche : il n'y aura pas d'eau demain matin. Elle veut peindre à sept heures. Elle demande au lecteur d'aller parler à M. Marchand dans le palier.
draft.setup_native: After the burnt omelette, Lila sees a notice: no water tomorrow morning. She asks you to ask Mr Marchand, politely (vous), to move the cut by an hour.
draft.objective_native: Ask Mr Marchand, politely (using vous), to move the water cut by one hour.
draft.objective_semantics: The learner must make a polite request to the landlord (vous form) asking him to change the scheduled water cut so the group's morning plans (Lila painting, Marin cooking) remain possible. This is a single communicative act: a polite, direct request with a reason.
draft.causal_reason: The burnt omelette and the smoke alarm made everyone scatter; Lila found the notice about the water cut and needs time tomorrow to paint.

chapter.dramatic_question: Pouvez-vous parler à M. Marchand pour décaler la coupure d'eau, et gagner la matinée de Lila ?
possible_developments: M. Marchand accepte de décaler la coupure d'une heure — nouvelle habitude.
Il refuse et la coupure reste — Lila et Marin doivent changer leurs plans.
Il propose une autre solution (une bouteille d'eau ou un plombier) et parle enfin au lecteur comme voisin.

panels.narration_fr: La cuisine sent la fumée. L'omelette a brûlé.

dialogue.text_native: This is the best failed dinner.

panels.visual_direction: Wide shot of Odile's small kitchen. The ceiling has a grey smear from the burnt omelette smoke. Lila and Marin stand by the stove; a pan black with smoke sits on the table.
panels.alt_native: Kitchen with two people and a burnt pan; smoke in the room.

panels.narration_fr: Sur la table, une affiche attire l'attention.
panels.visual_direction: Medium shot on the table where a printed notice lies face up. Lila's hand points to it; the learner is partly in frame, holding a towel.
panels.alt_native: A notice on the table saying there will be no water tomorrow morning; a hand points to it.

panels.narration_fr: Lila voulait peindre à sept heures. Marin voulait cuisiner.

dialogue.text_fr: Sans eau, je ne peux pas finir la soupe.
dialogue.text_native: Without water, I can't finish the soup.

dialogue.text_fr: Tu peux parler à M. Marchand ?
dialogue.text_native: Can you speak to Mr Marchand?

panels.visual_direction: Close-up on Marin and Lila. Marin sighs and gestures to the kettle; Lila looks worried about her paints.
panels.alt_native: Two people worry about plans: one holds a kettle, the other touches a paintbrush.

dialogue.text_fr: Ah, c'est vous. Vous voulez que je décale la coupure d'eau d'une heure ?
dialogue.text_native: Ah, it's you. Do you want me to delay the water cut by one hour?

panels.visual_direction: Medium shot through the open flat door onto the landing. M. Marchand is half in his doorway, door half closed behind him, a stack of bills in his hand. He looks surprised to see you on the landing.
panels.alt_native: A landlord stands in his doorway on the landing, holding papers, talking to the person in the flat.

draft.opening_line_fr: Ah, c'est vous. Vous voulez que je décale la coupure d'eau d'une heure ?
draft.suggested_response_fr: Monsieur Marchand, pouvez-vous décaler la coupure d'eau d'une heure, s'il vous plaît ?
draft.hint_native: Use the formal vous and say please. Give a short reason: Lila needs to paint and Marin needs to cook.
draft.translation_native: Ah, it's you. Do you want me to delay the water cut by one hour?

lexicon.gloss_native: water cut; scheduled stoppage of water

season_checklist.change_before: Tomorrow morning there will be a scheduled water cut in the building.
season_checklist.change_after: The learner will try to have the cut moved by one hour or leave it as is (decision pending).
season_checklist.hook_fr: À suivre… Marchand ferme la porte, mais il n'a pas répondu.
season_checklist.complication: If Marchand refuses, Lila must change her painting schedule and Marin must cook without water.

draft.dramatic_question: Quel mot transforme ce dîner raté en un souvenir chaleureux ?
draft.objective_native: Say one short sentence in French that will save the evening: show tenderness or complicity toward Lila or the group.

refusals.hint: The narration addresses the learner as "vous" while the character speaks to them as "tu". Pick one and use it everywhere: switching between tu and vous inside a scene reads as a mistake to a learner who is being taught the difference.
